desc: Going back to the basics with our Norma Whitetail line. When hunting season starts, you want to be able to count on your ammunition. Norma's Whitetail line of ammunition is loaded with the highest quality brass that meets and exceeds the standard set forth by reloaders. Norma's proven soft-point bullet, matched with our premium brass case allows for confidence in shot to shot performance. Norma Whitetail is designed to deliver the shot to shot performance you need to ensure your next hunt is always successful.
